svg.aria-label: The build-server workflow queues five jobs on two isolated runner slots, six build threads per job. Native and Linux jobs use the wn-cache-2 cache: native Linux runs the C/Odin suite, and Linux amd64 and arm64 run packaged startup tests. Windows and OpenBSD jobs use wn-cache-1: Windows amd64 runs packaged startup tests, and OpenBSD amd64 runs filesystem, helper and startup tests. macOS is not included and default-branch runner routing is unchanged.
